children: Japanese stocks may consolidate, tracking Wall Street's mixed performance overnight. Investors are eager to see U.S. CPI data due out later today for clues on the Fed's interest-rate increase trajectory. Economists surveyed by the Wall Street Journal expect the headline year-over-year CPI increase to be 3.6% for September, up from 3.4% in August. Nikkei futures opened 10 points higher at 68050 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.34 yen, compared with Y158.31 late Tuesday in New York. The Nikkei Stock Average closed 1.8% lower at 67777.52 on Tuesday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
